recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片細胞極多，幾乎全是顆粒球系各階段細胞（前骨髓細胞、骨髓細胞、後骨髓細胞、帶狀與分葉中性球），並可見深紫色顆粒的嗜鹼性球，原始細胞不多，這種「全階段顆粒球增生合併嗜鹼性球」是慢性期 CML 的典型骨髓。
features: Markedly hypercellular aspirate with granulocytic hyperplasia
Full spectrum of maturation: promyelocytes, myelocytes (predominant), metamyelocytes, bands and segmented neutrophils
Basophils with dark purple granules obscuring the nucleus
Blasts not increased; erythroid precursors relatively decreased
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is markedly hypercellular with striking granulocytic hyperplasia showing orderly maturation from promyelocytes through myelocytes, metamyelocytes, bands and segmented neutrophils, with a myelocyte predominance. Basophils and eosinophil precursors are readily identified. Blasts are not increased and erythroid precursors are relatively reduced. Findings are consistent with chronic myeloid leukemia, chronic phase; confirmation requires demonstration of t(9;22)/BCR-ABL1.

ddx.vs: Leukemoid reactions show toxic granulation and Döhle bodies without basophilia or eosinophilia and are BCR-ABL1 negative.
CNL shows predominantly mature neutrophils with few immature forms and no basophilia, and carries CSF3R mutations.
Atypical CML shows prominent dysgranulopoiesis without basophilia and lacks BCR-ABL1.
Advanced phases show increased blasts (10–19% or >=20%) or basophils >=20%, which are not seen here.
